scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana
description:
The Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh.

This scheme was officially launched on 1st February 2021.

The primary objective of this scheme is to empower construction workers by providing them with skill development opportunities.

The scheme aims to enhance the employability of construction workers through vocational training.

The government has set a target to train approximately 50,000 construction workers under this initiative.

The scheme also focuses on the overall family empowerment of the beneficiaries.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is structured to support the families of construction workers.

Eligible beneficiaries can receive financial aid of up to INR 10,000 for skill development training.

The assistance is provided in the form of a one-time grant to cover training costs.

The scheme also aims to provide job placements for trained individuals.

The eligibility criteria for this scheme include being a resident of Madhya Pradesh.

Beneficiaries must be registered construction workers under the Building and Other Construction Workers Act of 1996.

The age limit for applicants is between 18 years and 45 years.

Income criteria stipulate that the annual income of the family should not exceed INR 2 lakh.

Educational qualifications are not specifically mandated for eligibility.

The application process for this scheme involves several steps.

Interested applicants must first register as construction workers with the Madhya Pradesh Labour Department.

They need to fill out the application form available on the official website.

Required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhar card.

Applicants must also provide proof of residence in Madhya Pradesh.

They need to submit their registration certificate as a construction worker.

The application form must be submitted to the local Labour Department office.

After submission, the application will be verified by the concerned authorities.

Once verified, eligible applicants will be notified regarding their training schedule.

The training programs are conducted through various government and private training institutes.

The training duration typically ranges from 30 to 90 days depending on the skill being taught.

Disbursement of financial assistance occurs after the completion of the training program.

The government has established a timeline for the disbursement of funds.

Funds are generally disbursed within 15 days of the completion of training.

The implementing authority for this scheme is the Madhya Pradesh Labour Department.

The Labour Department is responsible for overseeing the registration of construction workers.

They also manage the training programs and disbursement of funds.

Contact details for the Madhya Pradesh Labour Department can be found on their official website.

The scheme has been designed to address the skill gap in the construction sector.

It aims to provide workers with skills that are in demand in the job market.

The initiative also seeks to improve the living standards of construction workers and their families.

By enhancing skills, the scheme aims to increase the earning potential of workers.

The government has allocated a budget of INR 50 crores for the initial phase of this scheme.

This budget is intended to cover training costs and provide financial assistance to beneficiaries.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to promote skill development in Madhya Pradesh.

It aligns with the national skill development mission launched by the Government of India.

The Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana is expected to create a skilled workforce.

This skilled workforce will contribute to the growth of the construction sector in the state.

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of safety training for construction workers.

Safety training is crucial given the risks associated with construction work.

The government aims to ensure that workers are aware of safety protocols and practices.

The scheme also encourages the participation of women in the construction workforce.

Women construction workers are provided with additional support under this initiative.

The government aims to empower women by providing them with equal training opportunities.

This initiative is expected to promote gender equality in the construction sector.

The scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders.

Construction industry experts have praised the initiative for its focus on skill development.

The scheme is also expected to reduce unemployment rates among construction workers.

By providing training and job placements, the government aims to create sustainable livelihoods.

The Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana is a significant step towards improving the socio-economic status of construction workers.

It represents a commitment by the Madhya Pradesh government to uplift marginalized communities.

The scheme is also expected to contribute to the overall economic development of the state.

The government plans to monitor the progress of the scheme regularly.

Regular assessments will help in understanding the impact of the training programs.

Feedback from beneficiaries will be collected to improve the scheme further.

The success of this initiative could lead to its expansion in the future.

The government is keen on replicating successful models in other states.

The Mukhyamantri Nirmaan Majadur Kaushal Vikaas evan Parivaar Sashaktikaran Yojana is a comprehensive approach to skill development.

It combines training with financial assistance to ensure holistic development for construction workers and their families.
